title: Tikhonov-Stabilized Bezier Representation Forecasting for Training-free Diffusion Acceleration
title_zh: 基于Tikhonov稳定化的贝塞尔表示预测：一种无需训练的扩散模型加速方法

paragraphs.en: 本文提出了一种名为BeziCast的扩散模型加速框架，利用贝塞尔轨迹预测去噪表示，有效减少了扩散模型推理阶段的成本。 Diffusion models, particularly Diffusion Transformers, achieve strong image and video generation quality but remain expensive at inference time due to repeated denoiser evaluations. Feature caching offers a deployment-friendly acceleration strategy by reusing or predicting intermediate representations without retraining the generator or modifying the sampler. However, existing cache-then-forecast methods often rely on Taylor-style finite-difference extrapolation, which can become unstable over longer cache intervals, and typically predict local module outputs whose errors may accumulate through subsequent denoiser blocks. We propose \textbf{BeziCast}, a training-free diffusion acceleration framework that forecasts output-proximal denoising representations using low-order B'ezier trajectories. BeziCast estimates B'ezier control points via Tikhonov-stabilized fitting, providing a smooth, capacity-controlled temporal parameterization that avoids explicit high-order derivative estimation and decouples trajectory capacity from cache-query density. To moderate aggressive extrapolation, we further derive equivalent forecasting weights and introduce a convex-hull-inspired guardrail that detects high-risk predictions and softly pulls them toward a conservative simplex-projected estimate. Extensive evaluations across advanced image and video diffusion models demonstrate the effectiveness of BeziCast. In particular, BeziCast accelerates FLUX.1 by up to (4.79\times) and HunyuanVideo by up to (4.11\times), while preserving substantially better generation quality than competing acceleration baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种名为BeziCast的扩散模型加速框架，利用贝塞尔轨迹预测去噪表示，有效减少了扩散模型推理阶段的成本。扩散模型，尤其是扩散Transformer，虽然能生成高质量的图像和视频，但由于需要重复执行去噪器评估，其推理阶段仍然成本高昂。 特征缓存提供了一种部署友好的加速策略，通过复用或预测中间表示，而无需重新训练生成器或修改采样器。 然而，现有的“先缓存后预测”方法通常依赖泰勒风格的有限差分外推法，这种方法在较长的缓存区间内可能变得不稳定，并且通常只能预测局部模块的输出，其误差可能会在后续的去噪器模块中累积。 我们提出了\textbf{BeziCast}——一种无需训练的扩散模型加速框架，它利用低阶贝塞尔轨迹来预测接近输出的去噪表示。 BeziCast通过Tikhonov稳定拟合来估计贝塞尔控制点，从而提供了一种平滑且容量受控的时间参数化方法，既避免了显式的高阶导数估计，又将轨迹容量与缓存查询密度解耦。 为了抑制激进的外推，我们进一步推导出了等效的预测权重，并引入了一种受凸包启发的防护机制，用于检测高风险预测，并将其柔和地拉向一个保守的单纯形投影估计值。 在多种先进的图像和视频扩散模型上进行的广泛评估，验证了BeziCast的有效性。 具体而言，BeziCast将FLUX.1的推理速度提升了最多（4.79\times），HunyuanVideo的速度提升了最多（4.11\times），同时其生成质量也显著优于现有的加速基线方法。
